about:
HomePlex Furniture operates from Indianapolis, Indiana, where it has been designing and selling custom luxury furniture since 2010. The company presents itself as a purveyor of "USA & Amish furniture" through a Central Indiana showroom, though the founder's name and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business focuses on made-to-order residential and office pieces, offering customers choice of size, arm style, leg style, cushion configuration, and fabric. Its product lineup spans living-room seating, dining sets, bedroom suites, and office furniture, with a noted emphasis on Amish-made construction and eight-way hand-tied upholstery. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

HomePlex serves primarily residential buyers and commercial offices, as suggested by its "Apartment Sofa" and "Office Furniture" categories. The showroom model implies direct-to-consumer sales, though the company does not list specific client names or industry verticals beyond the furniture categories shown.

The company highlights its "HONESTLY designing" ethos, free delivery on most orders, and a commitment to U.S. and Amish craftsmanship as distinguishing factors. These claims, drawn from its own website, frame the brand around transparency, domestic production, and service convenience.
